name: ou-on-en-est
description: Where things stand: every repo's branch, uncommitted and unpushed work, PR and CI; on your server, the deployed commit against main and changes made in place; and whether your pages answer. French or English.

projectsRoot.title: Projects folder
projectsRoot.description: Every git repo directly inside this folder is tracked. Empty: the current project and the repos next to it

extraRepos.title: Other repos
extraRepos.description: Comma-separated paths, on top of the projects folder

vpsHost.title: Server (ssh)
vpsHost.description: ssh host of your server (e.g. deploy@example.com); empty to skip it. Read-only, key-based ssh

vpsRepos.title: Repos on the server
vpsRepos.description: name=path on the server, comma-separated; the name matches the local repo, e.g. api=/srv/api

healthUrls.title: Pages to check
healthUrls.description: Comma-separated URLs whose HTTP status is shown
